title: Text Sharing
case_ids_frozen_by: P10 contract-freeze revision; Master Plan supplies requirements, not P10-Txxx identifiers

capability_contract.goal: Create, authorize, manage and expire Text resources with accurate public lifecycle/status and permanent UGC noindex/sitemap exclusion.
capability_contract.gate_scope: P10 closes CAP-TEXT and only the P10 UGC/noindex contribution to G7; release-wide G7 remains later-owned by P18/P19/P20/P22.

route_contract.workspace_api_authority_note: The approved IA names required text-share APIs and text detail/update/delete APIs but does not freeze exact Workspace HTTP method/path families. The following family is frozen by P10 as the current-repository implementation contract and must not be represented as IA-exact authority.

public_contract.page: GET /t/{slug}; POST /t/{slug} is the same-route password page action and may establish an opaque HttpOnly authorization cookie.
public_contract.machine: POST /api/public/text/{slug} is the registered server-mediated authorized public Text action for copy/download/one-time consumption; it repeats lifecycle and access checks.
public_contract.download: GET /t/{slug}?download=1 is a query input on the canonical PUB-TEXT path, not a second canonical URL; authorized success is text/plain attachment and denied states return zero content.

route_contract.legacy_aliases: PROHIBITED unless later specification change control creates a Route ID and removal plan

resource_contract.slug_authority: opaque server-generated public slug; internal IDs are not public path authority
resource_contract.content_authority: UTF-8 text is data, not executable markup; public rendering must not interpret user content as active HTML/script.
resource_contract.password_authority: optional password verifier is server-side only; plaintext password must not persist or enter URLs/logs.
resource_contract.expiry_authority: expires_at is server-authoritative; expired public access is 410.
resource_contract.consume_authority: one_time consumption is atomic; after successful authorized consumption, consumed_at is durable and later public access is 410.
resource_contract.delete_authority: removed/deleted public access is 410 and stale writes cannot resurrect authority
resource_contract.conflict_authority: versioned optimistic concurrency; stale mutation returns 409

seo_contract.shared_cache: UGC responses must not be incorrectly reused through shared caching

environment_contract.platformapi: Real native Go platformapi; fixture/in-memory substitution is insufficient for Exit evidence.
environment_contract.workspace_browser: Built Workspace app consuming real P10 APIs.
environment_contract.public_http: Real native platformapi/public Text HTTP handling with raw status/header/body evidence.

cases.name: Create and list Text shares persist authoritative Workspace state
cases.precondition: Real MySQL; authenticated Workspace manage actor.
cases.oracle: Create persists one same-Workspace Text resource with server-generated opaque slug, owner/version timestamps and default private authority; list returns only same-Workspace resources.

cases.name: Text input and mutation validation reject malformed authority
cases.precondition: Valid and malformed create/update payloads against real platformapi.
cases.oracle: Server validates required text/title/access/lifecycle fields; malformed writes fail without a partial usable resource or authority escalation.

cases.name: Authentication tenant isolation and RBAC protect Text CRUD
cases.precondition: Signed-out actor, two Workspaces, read-only and manage actors.
cases.oracle: Signed-out access is denied, read-only cannot mutate, cross-Workspace actors cannot infer or mutate resources, and manage permission is enforced server-side.

cases.name: Optimistic version conflict prevents lost Text updates
cases.precondition: One Text share with two concurrent/stale edit versions.
cases.oracle: Current version updates atomically; stale update returns conflict and cannot overwrite the committed resource.

cases.name: Delete and removal lifecycle is durable and non-resurrecting
cases.precondition: Existing private/public Text shares and manage actor.
cases.oracle: Delete/removal is authorized, durable and idempotent; removed resources cannot be restored by stale writes or public actions.

cases.name: Available public Text renders authorized plain text with HTTP 200
cases.precondition: Public unexpired Text share with safe title/content.
cases.oracle: GET /t/{slug} returns 200 and authorized content; user text is rendered as text rather than executable HTML/script and response does not leak private Workspace metadata.

cases.name: Private Text public access fails closed with HTTP 403
cases.precondition: Existing private Text share.
cases.oracle: Public page/API/download cannot expose private content; denial is 403 without content/title/tenant leakage.

cases.name: Password-gated Text requires server-authorized access
cases.precondition: Public password-protected Text share.
cases.oracle: Unauthenticated/wrong-password access is 401; successful same-route POST may establish only opaque HttpOnly authorization and later 200 access; password never enters URL/log/plaintext storage.

cases.name: Expired Text returns HTTP 410 and no content
cases.precondition: Public Text share whose expires_at is in the past.
cases.oracle: Page/API/copy/download return lifecycle-appropriate 410 with zero shared content and no 200 soft-404.

cases.name: One-time Text consumption is atomic and then returns HTTP 410
cases.precondition: Available one-time public Text share with concurrent authorized reads/actions.
cases.oracle: Exactly one authorized consumption can succeed; consumed_at is authoritative and subsequent page/API/copy/download access returns 410 without content.

cases.name: Unknown or malformed Text slug returns HTTP 404 without existence leakage
cases.precondition: Unknown and malformed public slugs plus cross-tenant internal IDs.
cases.oracle: Unknown/malformed public resources return 404, never 200 placeholder; response contains no tenant/internal identifier or stack detail.

cases.name: Copy and download preserve the same public authorization and lifecycle authority
cases.precondition: Available, password-gated, private, expired, consumed and removed Text fixtures.
cases.oracle: Copy uses only already-authorized rendered content; download is same-resource server output with text/plain attachment semantics and repeats access/lifecycle checks; denied states return zero content.

cases.name: Every Text UGC HTML and machine response is noindex
cases.precondition: All public Text lifecycle fixtures and public Text API responses.
cases.oracle: HTML carries robots noindex and response headers carry applicable X-Robots-Tag; API/machine responses carry X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow on success and error statuses.

cases.name: Text UGC is excluded from sitemap/canonical/hreflang and cannot soft-404
cases.precondition: Current route/SEO outputs and representative Text lifecycle responses.
cases.oracle: No /t/{slug} is emitted into Website/Docs sitemaps; PUB-TEXT has no canonical/hreflang/structured data; unknown/expired/removed/consumed use 404/410 rather than 200 soft-404.

cases.name: Public Text exposes the approved abuse entry without expanding P16 ownership
cases.precondition: Available and gated public Text surfaces.
cases.oracle: Public Text provides an accessible link to canonical /abuse/report; P10 does not create an alternate abuse route or claim CAP-ABUSE processing/admin completion.

cases.name: APP-TEXT list/create states are route-backed by real Text APIs
cases.precondition: Built Workspace and native platformapi with real MySQL fixtures.
cases.oracle: /app/text renders loading/empty/edit/read-only/error and applicable quota state from server authority; create/list tasks work without fixture-only success.

cases.name: APP-TEXT-DETAIL edit preview conflict expiry and deletion are route-backed
cases.precondition: Real Text fixtures for editable/read-only/conflict/expired/deleted states.
cases.oracle: /app/text/{shareId} reflects authoritative edit/read-only/preview/conflict/expired/deleted/error states and does not expose forbidden mutations.

cases.name: Workspace and public Text canonical tasks meet responsive and accessibility contract
cases.precondition: Real Workspace/Public Text routes at Design System canonical viewports.
cases.oracle: Required tasks pass 1440x900, 1024x768 and 390x844 captures plus 320 CSS px reflow; keyboard access, visible focus, non-color state meaning and reduced-motion remain usable.

cases.name: Exact-head P10 evidence coherence binds all producer evidence
cases.precondition: P10-T001..P10-T018 evidence produced by required workflows on one exact candidate SHA.
cases.oracle: All 18 case records/captures/header records bind the same exact implementation SHA and producer run IDs/digests with no missing or contradictory evidence.

cases.name: Signed exact-head P10 closure binds affected regressions and review
cases.precondition: P10-T001..P10-T019 PASS, accountable review signed, P0/P1/Decision Required zero and affected P00-P10 workflows green on the same signed SHA.
cases.oracle: Closure is PASS only on the signed exact head with exact-head evidence index and affected regression matrix; pre-sign closure is not merge-authoritative.

closure_contract.gate_scope: P10 CAP-TEXT G3 functional/API and P10 G7 UGC/noindex subset only; full G7 and later release ownership remain open.
